Built **Hollowlight**, a playable 3D story adventure, in `index.html`.

Explore the lantern-lit forest with WASD or arrow keys, meet a shy guardian, and use **Talk** or **Listen** to earn its trust. In the encounter, dodge the golden sparks; **Mercy** becomes available when the guardian is ready. Reach the old lantern to finish the journey. Touch controls are included for mobile.

To play locally, serve the project directory and open `index.html` in a browser. I also checked the rendered 3D scene in Chromium. I assumed an original, compact adventure inspired by Undertale’s dialogue-and-mercy encounter style.
